name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Inbound Sales Development | Lead Qualification, Speed-to-Lead, Meeting Booking & Salesforce
summary: Software sales professional who qualifies fast and books meetings that hold. Four years as a BDR booking sales-ready meetings for regional reps, then SaaS sales at Fivestars (up to 150 calls a day, up to 10 deals a month) and Accelo (top three on a team of 8 to 15 while quota doubled). Builds automated lead capture and follow-up systems, so I know what fast, consistent inbound response looks like. Works in Salesforce, HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Salesloft, and Apollo.
